verdict.rationale: Databricks publishes a first-party REST API reference covering types, paths, and request payloads. Many pages include request/response payload examples, and some include CLI, Terraform, or SDK snippets that a user could copy and run. However, no live try-it runner is documented, so the reference is a static explorer rather than an interactive one, and probes found no OpenAPI spec at any candidate path. Missing for 10: an interactive in-browser try-it/runnable console, a published OpenAPI spec, examples on every page, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples

citations.quote: Many reference pages also provide request and response payload examples. Some reference pages also provide examples for calling a Databricks REST API operation by using the Databricks CLI, the Databricks Terraform provider, or one or more of the Databricks SDKs.
This reference contains information about the Databricks workspace-level application programming interfaces (APIs).
